stories.title: President Uchtdorf honors German prisoners of war with other German consulate officials
stories.summary: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf, of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, joined German consulate officials Sunday at Fort Douglas Post Cemetery to honor 41 prisoners of war buried there.

stories.title: 32 Americans named as Rhodes scholars have variety of interests, from space junk to art history
stories.summary: A college senior who wants to clean up debris pollution in Earth's orbit and a student who has researched AI use in healthcare are among the 32 Americans named as 2027 Rhodes scholars.

stories.title: Utah avalanche forecasters urge preparation as ski season approaches
stories.summary: Before heading into the backcountry this season, avalanche experts urge recreationists to inspect and test their safety equipment.

stories.title: 76-year-old potter goes viral for making pottery with his cat
stories.summary: A Wisconsin potter has gained more than 300,000 social media followers by sharing pottery tutorials alongside his cat, Georgie, while using proceeds to support an after-school program for vulnerable children in Southern Africa.

stories.title: Father and daughter's dream hike at Zion National Park saved by strangers' kindness
stories.summary: What started as a frustrating weekend of disappointment became an unforgettable father-daughter adventure when the kindness of strangers helped them achieve their dream.

stories.title: Competency restored for woman accused of damaging North Salt Lake church building
stories.summary: A woman who is accused of shattering 19 windows at a church building in North Salt Lake was recently found competent to stand trial.

stories.title: Estonia to shut its border with Russia, blaming Moscow for foiled arson plot
stories.summary: Estonia is to close its border with Russia after blaming Moscow for a suspected attack on a defense technology company, Estonia's prime minister said Sunday.

stories.title: Dog killed in Vernal shooting, alleged gunman arrested on suspicion of attempted murder
stories.summary: A man who police say fired four rounds at another man's trailer, killing a dog inside, has been arrested.

stories.title: Cedar City piano teacher reflects on over 50 years teaching, says she's 'just getting started'
stories.summary: For more than 50 years, 70-year-old Cedar City piano teacher LuAnn Keate has mentored generations of rural Utah students — now including the children of her former pupils.

stories.title: After 26 years, the US has lost its measles elimination status
stories.summary: Thanks to widespread vaccination, measles had been considered "eliminated" as a continually transmitting illness in the United States since 2000, but not anymore.

stories.title: A 'distinctly Utah brand': How The Food Nanny went nationwide
stories.summary: The mother-daughter team behind Utah-based The Food Nanny has grown a family meal-planning cookbook into a thriving lifestyle brand with more than 500,000 Instagram followers, retail stores and a range of products.

stories.title: Utah mountain biker conquers Kilimanjaro on a broken leg
stories.summary: A Utah woman is now the first known woman to ride a bike up and down the highest mountain in Africa and the highest free-standing mountain in the world in a single day.
